statements.general: I, the undersigned, as the child's guardian, consent to the doctor examining and treating the child and carrying out the tests they need at this clinic. I may ask the doctor about any procedure before it is carried out, and I may withdraw this consent at any time without it affecting the child's right to receive care.
statements.examination: I consent to the doctor examining the child clinically, including physical examination and measurement of vital signs. It has been explained to me that the examination may require uncovering parts of the child's body, and that this is done in my presence.
statements.procedure: The doctor has explained to me the nature of the procedure proposed for the child and its purpose, what is expected of it, the possible risks, the available alternatives, and what may follow from not carrying it out. I have had the opportunity to ask questions and they were answered, and I consent to it being performed.
statements.vaccination: I have been told the name of the vaccine and the dose to be given to the child and its benefits, the common effects after it (a mild fever or soreness at the injection site), and the symptoms that mean returning to the clinic. I have had the chance to ask, and I consent to the vaccine being given.
statements.anesthesia: It has been explained to me what type of anaesthesia is planned for the child, its purpose and its possible risks, and I have told the doctor of any allergy the child has, any medicines they take, and any previous experience of anaesthesia. I consent to the anaesthesia and to the measures needed to keep the child safe during it.
statements.data_privacy: I consent to the clinic keeping the child's medical data in their file and using it to follow up their treatment and to issue the reports and invoices required. This data is not shared with any outside party except with my consent or where the law requires it. I have the right to see the file and to ask for anything in it to be corrected.
statements.photography: I consent to the child's condition being photographed or filmed for the medical purpose explained to me, and to it being kept in the child's file. It is not used for teaching or publication except with separate written consent and after removing anything identifying the child. I may withdraw this consent at any time, and that applies to anything not yet published.

backups.title: Backups
backups.hint: A safe, consistent snapshot of the database (even while running). Take one before any big change and download copies off this machine regularly.
backups.none: No backups yet — create the first one now.
backups.restored: Restored successfully — an automatic snapshot was taken first ({pre})
backups.restore_prompt: Restoring replaces the entire current database (an automatic snapshot is taken first). Type RESTORE to confirm:
backups.auto_hint: The automatic backup is taken on the first use of the system after the chosen hour. Each kind has its own schedule and its own number of copies to keep, so the small daily snapshots cannot push the full archives off the end. Retention applies to automatic backups only — manual ones are never deleted automatically. When both fall due on the same day only the full one is taken, because it covers the other. A backup is also taken before every database upgrade.
backups.upload_hint: Upload a backup file (.db) from your device — it is checked to be a healthy database belonging to this program, then appears in the list and can be restored with the same safe restore flow.
backups.upload_not_sqlite: The file is not a valid SQLite database.
backups.upload_too_big: The file exceeds the allowed size.
backups.upload_corrupt: The file is corrupt — integrity check failed.
backups.upload_wrong_app: The file is a database but does not belong to this program.
backups.uploaded: Uploaded: {name} — you can restore from it in the list.
backups.include_files_hint: Pictures are not inside the database — the file is on disk and the database only holds its name. Without this, a restore brings every record back with a broken image beside it: patient and staff photos, the clinic logo, doctors' signatures and stamps, attached documents. This setting covers the safety snapshots taken automatically before a restore or an upgrade — manual and scheduled backups now each state their own kind.
backups.no_files_hint: This snapshot was taken as the database alone, so it carries no pictures.
backups.pwd_hint: New snapshots are written as AES-256 ZIP — 7-Zip and any other archiver opens them with the passphrase.
backups.pwd_warn: A backup holds every patient the clinic has seen: names, phone numbers, diagnoses, photographs. On a flash drive or sent over WhatsApp, whoever picks it up reads all of it. Set a passphrase.
backups.pwd_lost: There is no recovery for this passphrase. Lose it and the backups made with it are gone — one we could recover is one an intruder could recover.
backups.pwd_scope: Applies to new snapshots only. Existing ones still need the passphrase they were made with; the program asks for it when restoring.
backups.pwd_set: Backup passphrase saved. New snapshots will be encrypted.
backups.pwd_cleared: Backup passphrase removed. New snapshots will be unencrypted.
backups.pwd_mismatch: The two entries do not match.
backups.pwd_failed: Could not write to clinic.env — check the file is not read-only.
backups.bad_password: Wrong passphrase — this backup was made with a different one.
backups.newer_refused: This backup was taken by a newer version of the program than the one installed here, so it was not restored. Update first (update.bat), then restore it.
backups.upgraded_from: The backup was from version {version} — the database shape was brought forward after restoring.
backups.kind_db_hint: Small and quick — records and money, without the pictures. This is the one to take daily.
backups.kind_full_hint: The database plus every uploaded file. Much larger, so it runs on a wider rhythm.
backups.full_never: No full backup has ever been taken
backups.full_stale_hint: The copy holding your pictures is old. If the disk failed now, every record would come back with a broken image beside it — take a full backup, or check its schedule.
backups.unlock_forgot: Forgotten it? Type your own sign-in password
backups.unlock_confirm: Backups from now on will be taken unencrypted. Continue?
backups.unlock_denied: Not unlocked: the password you typed does not match.
backups.unlock_scope: This affects future backups only. Archives already on disk keep the passphrase they were written with.

tills.check_clearing: owed to you, not arrived yet
tills.under_min: below its minimum — not enough change
tills.computed_hint: The balance is computed from the opening figure and every movement — never a stored column.
tills.none: No tills configured. Run upgrade-db to create the defaults.
tills.no_moves: No movements on this till yet.
tills.landed_in: {method}: this money landed in \u201c{till}\u201d, not in the cash drawer.
tills.move_hint: Bank the drawer · draw out · transfer · settle the card account.
tills.pending_hint: Balances under collection: card not yet in the bank, cheques not collected, insurance unpaid.
tills.no_target: no settlement till — this can never clear
tills.err_bad_amount: The amount must be more than zero.
tills.err_bad_fee: Bad fee — it must be less than the amount.
tills.err_no_target: A transfer needs a destination till.
tills.err_same_till: A till cannot transfer to itself.
tills.err_cross_currency: Those tills hold different currencies — cross-currency transfers are not built yet.
tills.err_fee_needs_transfer: A fee only applies to transfers and settlements.
tills.err_insufficient: That till does not hold this much.
tills.branch_hint: Free text — this program has no branch entity yet.
tills.min_hint: The least it can hold and still make change.
tills.max_hint: Above this it says \u201cbank it\u201d — the limit that actually protects money.
tills.fee_percent_hint: What this till's machine or bank keeps. A suggestion only — the figure typed at settlement is what counts.
tills.settles_hint: Where this settles — without it the balance can never clear.
tills.methods_hint: Methods that land here by default. The cashier can send one payment elsewhere.
tills.count_hint_cash: Count the notes and type the figure. The program compares it with what should be there.
tills.count_hint_bank: Open the statement and type the balance on it.
tills.count_hint_wallet: Open the app and type the balance in it.
tills.count_hint_clearing: Type what the provider says is still owed to you.
tills.counted_diff: Count recorded. The {diff} difference needs explaining by a manager.
tills.diffs_hint: A till short every week and always closed off by whoever counted it is what this list exists to show.
tills.needs_admin: Only a manager can close this difference.
tills.err_need_reason: Write the reason — \u201cadjusted\u201d with nothing beside it is the audit trail failing at the one moment it exists for.
tills.not_your_till: This till is not assigned to you.
tills.assigned_hint: Leave empty = a shared till anyone with the permission may work. Name people = the till is theirs alone (its owner always included).
tills.settle_after_hint: How long this machine's money normally takes to land. It decides when the screen says "late" — the program never posts a settlement on its own.
tills.settle_suggest_hint: These figures are a filled-in suggestion. Check them against the bank statement before recording — the statement is the authority on what arrived and what the machine kept.

recon.title: Bank reconciliation
recon.subtitle: The till's balance is the program's claim; the statement is the world's. This screen exists for the lines that do not match.
recon.statement_total_hint: Sum of the imported lines, excluding those set aside.
recon.program_total_hint: Sum of this till's movements as the program has them.
recon.open_items_hint: From both sides — this is the work left.
recon.import_hint: CSV or Excel, as the bank exported it. Headers are recognised in Arabic and English; Arabic-Indic digits, thousands separators and bracketed negatives all read correctly.
recon.columns_hint: A date column and an amount column (or debit and credit) are required. Description, reference and balance are optional and useful.
recon.auto_hint: Matches a line only when exactly one movement has the same amount within {days} days. Two candidates is a question for a person.
recon.unmatched_hint: Money the bank knows about that the clinic never recorded: bank charges, direct debits, a collection that went missing.
recon.no_candidate_hint: No movement at this amount within the window — either it was never recorded, or the dates are further apart.
recon.missing_hint: The more alarming side: money the clinic recorded that never arrived. (Shown only up to the statement's last day — anything after it has not had its chance yet.)
recon.no_lines: No statement imported for this till yet.
recon.err_unsupported_file: The file must be a CSV or an XLSX.
recon.err_empty_file: The file is empty or unreadable.
recon.err_no_date_column: No date column found in the statement.
recon.err_no_amount_column: No amount column (nor debit/credit) found in the statement.
recon.err_nothing_readable: Not one line could be read — check the column names.
recon.err_not_reconcilable: A cash drawer has no statement — it is checked by counting.
recon.err_already_matched: That line is already matched — undo it first.
recon.err_movement_taken: That movement is already linked to another line.
recon.err_need_note: Write the reason — “set aside” with nothing beside it tells the next person nothing.

studies.none: No studies recorded for this child yet.

live.changed: This page has changed — somebody recorded something new.

phones.title: Missing phone numbers
phones.subtitle: Who the clinic cannot reach — add the number from here.
phones.group_unreachable_hint: No number of theirs and none for a guardian — no appointment reminder, no call about a result, no way to say the clinic is closed. These come first.
phones.group_teens_hint: The family is reachable; the young person is not.
phones.bad_number: That has no digits in it — please type it again
phones.all_clear: Every active patient has a contact number ✅

about.title: About
about.subtitle: The project, its plan and who is behind it — plus version and licence.
about.no_doctors: No people have been added yet.
about.en_optional: English is optional — leave it blank and the Arabic is shown in both languages.
about.photo_hint: A square picture works best — it is cropped to a circle.
about.support_hint: If something is wrong, copy this block and send it — it holds everything the first call asks for. No patient data and no passwords.
about.backup_stale: The last backup is more than a week old.
about.backup_never: No backup has ever been taken.
about.not_a_user: — not a user of the program —
about.link_user_hint: Pick a colleague and their name and photograph are read straight from their profile, so nothing here needs updating. Leave it empty for anybody without a login — a supervisor, the owner, somebody who helped.

history_import.title: Import case history
history_import.subtitle: If the clinic was running on another program, bring across the services and vaccinations its patients received — so it does not lose its history.
history_import.patients_first_hint: This file attaches history to patients that already exist; it cannot create them, because a services export carries no date of birth, gender or phone. If you have not imported your patients yet, start there.
history_import.upload_hint: Upload your program's export as it is — the columns are matched by their headers, and you can correct any of them next.
history_import.template_hint: The template is a convenience, not a requirement — most exports work without renaming a single column.
history_import.map_hint: This is a suggested mapping — check it and change what needs changing. Starred fields are required.
history_import.summary_hint: These are not data — they are a summary block sitting in the same sheet, and they will be ignored:
history_import.states_hint: "Already imported" is not an error — it is the normal state of uploading the same file again. "Changed" means the row was edited in your old program, and you decide whether to take the new value.
history_import.missing_patients: Patient codes that do not exist here
history_import.missing_hint: These rows will be rejected. Import these patients first, then upload the file again.
history_import.showing_first: Showing the first {n} rows — the import runs on the whole file.
history_import.need_columns: You must map at least: service date, patient code and service
history_import.span_hint: The whole file is imported by default. To take part of it, set the dates — rows outside the range are set aside, not rejected.
history_import.link_hint: Your file has thousands of rows but only a handful of distinct names, so you confirm this once. The program proposes from your own services and from the vaccine catalogue, and you decide — nothing is linked to a child until you confirm it. A name with no counterpart here is left unlinked and keeps its text.
history_import.batches_hint: Every import that has been run, by whom and when — and any of them can be taken back.
history_import.no_batches: No import has been run yet
history_import.undo_confirm: This removes everything this import added. Anything the clinic corrected or recorded itself is kept. Continue?
history_import.already_undone: This import has already been undone
history_import.in_file_hint: Services brought across from the program this clinic used before. The vaccinations among them became real vaccination records and appear on the vaccinations tab. These amounts are history only — they do not enter the till or the financial reports.
history_import.doctors_hint: The doctors in your file are matched to users you already have. Without this, a doctor's past work stays outside the commission reports and the doctor statements.
history_import.categories_hint: Your file's “contract” column is matched to your client categories. Left as text it never reaches the discount aimed at that category.
history_import.make_user: Create an inactive user with this name
history_import.will_create_hint: These are doctors in your file with no user here, and you asked for them. The account is created inactive — it cannot sign in — so their past work is attached to a person in the commission reports and the tax export. If the doctor still works with you, activating them is one click on the users screen. Nothing is created until you press import.
history_import.missing_kept: Their history is not lost. Nothing is imported for them and nothing is thrown away either — the rows stay in your file, and re-uploading it once the patients exist picks them up, because a second upload compares instead of appending.
history_import.missing_download: Download the missing patients as an import sheet
history_import.no_missing: No missing patients in this file — every code found a patient here.
history_import.missing_sheet_1: This file holds the patients your services export names that do not exist here yet — their code and name are already filled in from your file.
history_import.missing_sheet_2: Fill in date_of_birth and gender — both are required, and a services export carries neither. The date of birth in particular drives every vaccination due date and growth centile, so a guessed one is a wrong dose date for a real child.
history_import.missing_sheet_3: When it is filled: upload it under “Import patients”, then upload the services file again — it will find them and add their history without duplicating what was imported before.
history_import.count_money: Count this import’s money as clinic earnings
history_import.count_money_hint: Unticked, the amounts are kept as history on the patient file only — outside the till and outside today’s collection. Ticked, they appear as a separate line marked "imported" on the money screens. Leave it unticked when importing old years, or the same money is counted twice against the accountant’s opening balances.

payer_types_admin.title: Entity kinds
payer_types_admin.hint: These are yours to rename and extend. The key beside each name never changes — every entity stores it, and “cash” in particular is how the program recognises your own price list. A kind in use cannot be deleted; hide it instead.
payer_types_admin.key_fixed: The key is fixed — every entity stores it; only the name changes.
payer_types_admin.system_kept: This is a built-in kind — you can rename or hide it, but not delete it.
payer_types_admin.in_use: {n} entities are filed under this kind. Hide it instead of deleting, so they stay as they are.

discount_members.title: Discount members
discount_members.find_hint: Type a name or file number…
discount_members.none: Nobody is named on this discount yet.
discount_members.members_only_hint: Off: the list tops the rule up — everyone the rule covers gets it, plus whoever you name. On: only the named people, and the rule is ignored.
discount_members.only_on: This discount is for the people named here only — the rule is ignored.
discount_members.only_off: This list tops the rule up: everyone the rule covers gets the discount, plus whoever is named here.
discount_members.exclusion_wins: An excluded person never gets the discount, whatever the rule says — taking somebody off here really takes them off.

siblings.search_hint: Type the sibling's name or file number…
siblings.suggested_hint: Found by the family part of the name or by a parent's phone. Check them and link the ones who really are — nothing is linked on its own.
siblings.in_other_family: In another family — linking will move them here
siblings.auto_hint: Links the one case matching on both the phone and the name.
siblings.auto_linked: {name} was linked automatically — check it, and unlink if wrong.
siblings.no_certain_match: No case matches closely enough to link automatically.
siblings.need_family: This patient has no family yet — add a guardian first.
siblings.merged: {name} joined this family; their old one was removed as it was left empty.
siblings.same_name_family: A second family record with the same name — link to merge them

rooms.title: Clinics
rooms.assign_title: Who is in which clinic today
rooms.assign_hint: Recorded per day, because a doctor is not in the same clinic every day.
rooms.deactivated_instead: This clinic is used on earlier days, so it was switched off instead of deleted to keep the history readable.
rooms.number_hint: The clinic number is generated automatically — it is not typed.

lookups.title: Store lists
lookups.subtitle: Item types, categories, units and warehouse kinds — all added, edited and removed here.
lookups.cannot_delete: Cannot be deleted — will be switched off
lookups.deactivated_system: This is a built-in entry, so it was switched off instead.
lookups.deactivated_in_use: This entry is used by existing items, so it was switched off instead of deleted to keep them readable.
lookups.guard_hint: An entry that is in use, or built in, is switched off rather than deleted — so nothing is left pointing at something that no longer exists.

phrases.title: Quick phrases and shortcuts
phrases.intro: These are your own phrases — a diabetes clinic is not a neonatal one, and a cardiologist is not an endocrinologist. Anything you leave empty falls back to the clinic's list.
phrases.code_title: A short code that writes a long sentence
phrases.code_hint: Type the code in the complaint, examination or plan box and press space — the whole phrase is written in its place.
phrases.code_example: For example: "normal" writes the whole normal-examination paragraph, and "heart" writes the cardiac examination you say every day.
phrases.from_clinic: This is the clinic's list — saving here makes it yours.
phrases.empty_means_clinic: Clear every line in a box to go back to the clinic's list.
phrases.clinic_is_a_start: This is the clinic's list — where every doctor starts, and each can keep their own.

icd11.hint: ICD-10 is bundled in full (71,787 codes) and works offline. The WHO does not distribute ICD-11 as a file — the clinic registers with them free, gets two keys, and the program downloads it once and is offline again, exactly like ICD-10.
icd11.release_hint: Leave blank for whatever the WHO currently calls latest. Set something like 2024-01 to pin a release.
icd11.not_loaded: Not downloaded yet — doctors are not offered the option until it is.
icd11.import_hint: Takes a few minutes — leave the page open. Done once.
icd11.import_ok: ICD-11 downloaded: {n} codes. Doctors are now offered it.
icd11.error_who_bad_credentials: The WHO rejected the keys. Re-copy the Client ID and Secret from your account page with them.
icd11.error_who_not_configured: The Client ID and Secret have not been entered yet.
icd11.error_who_empty: The WHO returned no codes — nothing was written. The program walked {n} entities; a small number means the starting address was wrong.
icd11.progress_lost: Lost contact with the program during the import — check the count below before retrying.

flags.title: Payment flag
flags.blocked_booking: This file carries a temporary payment block. Booking needs an admin or financial authority.
flags.override: Allow this booking despite the block
flags.need_reason: Write the reason — a flag without one is a note nobody can judge.
flags.no_permission_clear: Clearing a payment flag needs financial authority or an admin.
flags.staff_only: Internal staff note — never appears on anything the family is handed.

meds.title: Ongoing medicines
meds.hint: What the child is currently taking. These are included in the interaction check when a new drug is written.
meds.name: Medicine
meds.unlinked: Not linked to the drug reference — excluded from the interaction check
meds.reconcile_hint: For each ongoing medicine: continue, stop or modify. The decision is recorded under your name and this visit's date.
meds.reconciled: Every medicine reviewed at this visit

station.title: Nursing stations
station.none_covered: This station has no clinics assigned yet.
station.empty: Nobody in this station's clinics right now.
station.subtitle: Each station and the clinics it covers — so nursing sees only its own.
station.explainer: A station is a fixed place beside certain clinics, so you pick clinics rather than doctors. Who is in each clinic today is read from the rota, so a doctor moving room updates the station by itself.
station.none_hint: Without stations the nursing screen shows the whole clinic — which is fine if you only have one.

vplan.title: Agreed vaccination plan
vplan.hint: What you agree here is followed and chased; everything else stays a suggestion by age.
vplan.supplied_hint: Followed, but never counted into a purchase order.

vplans.title: Cases on a plan
vplans.sub: Who we agreed what with, and what is still owed.
vplans.no_plans_hint: Agree vaccines on any child's file and they appear here.
vplans.order: Purchase order for what is shown
vplans.outside_note: Family supplies it — not in the order

vmix.limited: Mixed series — limited data, clinician review preferred
vmix.conditional: Conditional switch — check the product leaflet
vmix.under_age: Switched under {months} months — not established in the label
vmix.none: Earlier product's doses do not count towards this one
vmix.title: Interchangeability note

vreview.title: Clinical review required
vreview.why_undated_dose: A dose is recorded with no date, and the whole schedule is computed from dates.
vreview.why_duplicate_dose: A dose number appears twice in the record.
vreview.why_more_than_scheduled: More doses are recorded than the schedule has.
vreview.why_out_of_order: The dose dates do not run in the order of their numbers.
vreview.why_guideline_silent: The reference this clinic follows does not cover this case, and the program will not guess.
vreview.why_guideline_unsettled: The reference recommends vaccinating at this age but does not fix the number of doses — the doctor decides.
vreview.hint: This record cannot be scheduled from — the program will not guess.

labs.none: No test yet has a number recorded twice or more.

panels.title: Specialty panel
panels.reads_hint: Read from the vitals above — not asked again.
panels.unknown: This visit was recorded under a panel named \u201c{key}\u201d that this program no longer has. Its readings are kept.
panels.pick_then_save: Choose one and save the visit to see its fields.

mine.title: My clinic
mine.newold_hint: New means the child's first-ever visit to the clinic falls in this window — not their first with you.
mine.nothing_billed: Nothing was billed in this window.
mine.no_payouts_yet: This is what you have earned in the window. The program does not yet record money paid out to a doctor, so it cannot say what is still owed — that would be a guess, not a figure.
